title: A Terminal for the Protocol
author: Wren Kavanagh
blurb: Cyrus Marchetti, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
